summary: Iteration 40 — PHASE 2 Student-side Assignments (hybrid dashboard + milestone submit page). FULL PASS across backend (19/19 new + 66/66 regression = 85/85 combined) and frontend (all Phase 2 review items verified via Playwright). BACKEND: Created /app/backend/tests/test_assignments_phase2.py (6 test classes / 19 tests): (1) TestStudentAssignmentsDashboard — non-student & super_admin both get 403 (only role=='student' allowed); response shape validates {cohort_id, cohort_name, total_weeks, current_week, this_week[], assignments[]}; auto-seeds 4 default assignments when cohort has none (via _seed_default_assignments_for_cohort called on the endpoint); milestone.status correctly derived from submissions (pending→submitted, draft/reviewed→under_review, sent→feedback_provided, no sub→not_started); current_week is min week among not_started milestones across ALL 4 assignments (verified by seeding subs for weeks 1-3 → current_week==4); current_week==None + this_week==[] when everything submitted; enrolled-only isolation (outsider student sees only their own cohorts). (2) TestMilestoneSubmitEndpoint — 400 without assignment_id; 404 for unknown assignment_id; 404 for unknown milestone_id within valid assignment; 403 for non-enrolled student; 403 for instructor role. (3) TestFileTypeValidation — 60_second_pitch rejects .pdf (400 with 'Allowed file types' in body); accepts .mp4 (200 + submission persisted with assignment_id/milestone_id/cohort_id/student_id all set + is_resubmission=False). (4) TestQuestionnaireSubmission — required-field missing → 400 with the field label in error body; successful submit persists ALL questionnaire_answers keyed by field id. (5) TestResubmission — 2nd POST same (student, assignment_id, milestone_id) returns is_resubmission=True + SAME submission_id (updated in place) + exactly ONE doc in db.submissions + resubmission_count==1 + file_name replaced + status back to pending. (6) TestLegacyMaterialSubmitRegression — POST /api/materials/{id}/submit still works unchanged for legacy homework materials. REGRESSION: 66/66 pass together with test_assignments_phase1 (26) + test_assignment_templates (24) + test_rubric_library (16) in 33.28s. FRONTEND (Playwright, ephemeral session token TEST_ITER40_tok_7432180e...): (a) /dashboard as role=student renders 'student-assignments-dashboard' (NOT StudentDashboard.js); cohort-name-{cohort_id} shows the name; 'Week 1 of 14' visible when current_week=1. (b) 'this-week-panel-{cohort_id}' renders with all 4 this-week-item-{milestone_id} entries (one per assignment at week 1); each is a Link with href '/submit/a/{aid}/w/1?cohort={cid}'; icons match submission_type (Mic for 60s, Presentation for slides, FileText for case, ListChecks for questionnaire). (c) 4 'assignment-section-{aid}' cards below; each shows '0 / 14 milestones submitted' + progress bar; 'assignment-expand-{aid}' toggles the panel; expanded panel renders 14 'milestone-row-{ms_id}' entries sorted by week with the correct 'Not started' status badge. (d) Clicking a this-week-item navigates to /submit/a/{aid}/w/1?cohort={cid} → 'milestone-submit-page' renders with 'milestone-submit-title' = '60-Second Elevator Pitch', shows 'Week 1 · Week 1' (milestone title from auto-seed is literally 'Week N'), the correct file picker (MP4/MOV/M4V/MP3/M4A/WAV extension hint from SUBMISSION_TYPE_CONFIG.60_second_pitch), and Submit disabled until file selected. 'milestone-drive-link' absent when no drive_folder_url set (correct). (e) Business questionnaire route (asgn_id of business_questionnaire) → 'milestone-questionnaire-form' with 2 fields (milestone-questionnaire-field-q_biz_name + q_biz_desc); required field marked with red '*'; Submit disabled until required filled; enables after filling. (f) Signed-OUT visit to /submit/a/{aid}/w/1 shows 'milestone-submit-signin' card with 'milestone-login-btn'. (g) Bogus assignment_id /submit/a/asgn_nope_bogus/w/1 → 'stable-link-not-found' card renders. (h) Empty-state — student with no cohort sees 'You’re not enrolled in any cohort yet.' message + no cohort-section-* rendered. No console errors during any flow (one 404 was expected — the bogus-assignment test).

issues: Auto-seeded milestone titles are literally 'Week 1', 'Week 2', ... — the submit page subtitle then reads 'Week 1 · Week 1' which is redundant/awkward. Consider showing 'Week 1' only when milestone.title matches the pattern /^Week \d+$/, otherwise 'Week N · <title>'. Purely cosmetic — not blocking. Real cohorts with edited milestone titles will render correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2596 submit_milestone resolves cohort_id from asgn['cohort_id'] when the query param is omitted — good defensive fallback so a stale link that dropped the cohort query still resolves.

server.py:2608 IDEMPOTENCY key is (student_id, assignment_id, milestone_id, cohort_id). Correct for the assignment-first model. Note: the cohort_id inclusion means a student re-enrolled across cohorts would keep separate submissions per cohort — that's the intended isolation.

server.py:2609 delete_file_from_doc(existing) is called BEFORE the new gridfs_id is saved. If save_bytes_to_gridfs later fails, the OLD file is already gone — a partial-failure could leave the student with a broken submission. Not blocking for MVP but consider try/except with save first, then delete.
server.py:2643 File-ext validation uses SUBMISSION_TYPE_CONFIG[submission_type]['extensions'] and falls back to DEFAULT_HOMEWORK_EXTENSIONS for unknown types. Correct.

server.py:2677 material_id=asgn.get('material_id') or '' — for milestone-scoped submissions material_id is always '' since assignments don't have material_id. This is fine, but SubmissionQueryTests elsewhere may filter by material_id='' — worth a spot-check in Phase 3 that Coach Max prompts/insights still work correctly for assignment-linked submissions with no material_id.

server.py:3316 status mapping — 'reviewed' maps to 'under_review' (not to 'feedback_provided'). Correct: 'reviewed' means instructor has looked at it but not sent feedback yet; only status='sent' with ai_feedback populated maps to 'feedback_provided'. Consistent with iteration 38 review flow.
server.py:3322 ai_feedback field in submission_summary prefers instructor_feedback over ai_feedback — good for the case where instructor edited before sending.

StudentAssignmentsDashboard.js:107 shows 'All caught up!' only when this_week==[] AND at least one assignment has milestones. Correct — avoids the misleading 'All caught up' state for a freshly created empty cohort.
StudentAssignmentsDashboard.js:200 milestone circle color logic — capstone always purple, feedback_provided green, else default blue. Matches review-request spec.

DirectSubmit.js:329-334 resolver fetches /api/cohorts/{id}/assignments then finds the assignment by id — this requires the student to be enrolled (403 otherwise). If a student clicks a Thinkific-embedded link BEFORE enrollment, they'll see the sign-in card fine, but AFTER sign-in they'd hit a 403 rendered as generic 'stable-link-not-found'. Consider a friendlier 'You need to be enrolled in this cohort to submit' error message. Not blocking.

DirectSubmit.js:408-412 comments still reference 'the current /materials/{id}/submit endpoint requires a material_id' and 'POST /api/milestones/{milestone_id}/submit is not defined yet' — stale doc comment; the endpoint IS now defined (server.py:2574) and being used correctly on line 419. Just a doc-cleanup nit — safe to remove those obsolete comments.

App.js:86 DashboardRouter — student role fallback (any user with user.role !== 'instructor'/'super_admin') routes to StudentAssignmentsDashboard. This is a broad match — if a user has role=null it goes through the earlier useEffect redirect to /role-selection. Correct guard order.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 40 = Phase 2 (final piece of the Knowledge Base/Assignments split). Backend: /app/backend/tests/test_assignments_phase2.py is the canonical regression for the student dashboard + milestone submit endpoints; keep it in the standard suite. Combine with phase1 + templates + rubric for full regression: `cd /app && export $(grep -v '^#' /app/backend/.env | xargs) && export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_assignments_phase2.py /app/backend/tests/test_assignments_phase1.py /app/backend/tests/test_assignment_templates.py /app/backend/tests/test_rubric_library.py -v` (~40s, 85 tests). Frontend: StudentAssignmentsDashboard.js is now the default /dashboard for students (App.js:86); old StudentDashboard.js is dead code but kept for reference per E1's note. AssignmentMilestoneSubmit component + _resolverView helper in DirectSubmit.js handle the /submit/a/{aid}/w/{w} route. Key testids validated: student-assignments-dashboard, cohort-name-*, this-week-panel-*, this-week-item-*, assignment-section-*, assignment-expand-*, milestone-row-*, milestone-submit-signin, milestone-login-btn, milestone-submit-page, milestone-submit-title, milestone-drive-link, milestone-file-input, milestone-questionnaire-form, milestone-questionnaire-field-*, milestone-questionnaire-input-*, milestone-submit-btn, milestone-submitted, stable-link-not-found. Auto-seeded questionnaire_fields is [] by default — instructors need to add fields explicitly via the assignment editor for the questionnaire flow to be usable. Pre-existing audio/video test failures from iter 35 remain out of scope (ignored via --ignore flags). One tiny design nit noted in frontend_issues.design_issues: 'Week 1 · Week 1' subtitle on submit page is redundant when milestone.title auto-generates as 'Week N'.
rca of the issue: No production bugs found this iteration. One initial test failure was self-inflicted: I assumed the auto-seeded business_questionnaire assignment came with questionnaire_fields pre-populated, but it defaults to [] (instructors are expected to fill it in). Fixed by injecting a required + optional field in the test setup. Everything else worked first-try — E1's implementation is clean and matches the review-request spec exactly, and Phase 1/Templates/Rubric regressions all remain green.
